description: Source code for managing loose object mappings in a Git repository, including functions for initializing, loading, writing, and clearing loose object maps, as well as handling object ID pairs and file I/O operations.

methods.name: should_use_loose_object_map
methods.description: Determines if loose object map should be used based on repository's compatibility hash algorithm and git directory.

methods.name: loose_object_map_init
methods.description: Initializes a loose_object_map structure with new hash maps.

methods.name: insert_oid_pair
methods.description: Inserts a pair of object IDs into a hash map, allocating memory for the stored object ID.

methods.name: insert_loose_map
methods.description: Inserts object ID pairs into the loose object map and updates the object tree cache.

methods.name: load_one_loose_object_map
methods.description: Loads a loose object map from a file into memory, parsing object ID pairs.

methods.name: repo_read_loose_object_map
methods.description: Reads all loose object maps for the repository, loading them from disk.

methods.name: repo_write_loose_object_map
methods.description: Writes the current loose object map to disk.

methods.name: write_one_object
methods.description: Appends a single object ID pair to the loose object index file.

methods.name: repo_add_loose_object_map
methods.description: Adds a new object ID pair to the loose object map and writes it to disk if inserted.

methods.name: repo_loose_object_map_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the mapped object ID for a given source object ID from the loose object maps.

methods.name: loose_object_map_clear
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a loose object map and destroys hash maps.
